distribution.summary: 中国大陆（区域记录，未细化至省级）；西南中国；台湾
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) reports only 'Southwest China' for mainland occurrence; no province-level inference is promoted. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently reports China (SW) and Taiwan and directly confirms Taiwan, including Nantou, Neimoupu. Taiwan is therefore promoted to Present while mainland geography remains coarse.

host_note: No specific host taxon is promoted. Beaver & Liu (2010) characterizes the species as polyphagous, but this broad host-use statement remains contextual.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Euwallacea destruens (Blandford, 1896).
